events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran has led to increased tensions in the Middle East, with potential implications for global oil prices and market volatility. The US and its allies are considering further military action, while Iran has threatened to retaliate. The situation remains highly uncertain and fluid.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher prices and increased market volatility. A further escalation of the conflict could lead to a significant increase in oil prices, benefiting oil-related stocks and ETFs. On the other hand, a de-escalation of the conflict could lead to a decrease in oil prices, negatively impacting oil-related stocks and ETFs.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and adjust position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close position if oil prices stabilize or decrease
